src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: May 24, 2022 Amended Interim Proclamation Plan (20 Senate districts)
Alaska Redistricting Board, Amended Interim Proclamation of Redistricting, May 24, 2022 ('shall be implemented for legislative elections in the year 2022, and thereafter')

The Board's Nov 10, 2021 plan was sent back by the Alaska Supreme Court (Mar 25, 2022, over Senate District K and House District 36); the Board's Apr 13, 2022 amended plan was found an unconstitutional gerrymander by the superior court (May 16, 2022), which ordered an interim plan for 2022; the Board proclaimed it May 24, 2022. Three versions existed in 2022, but only this one was on the ballot. Census' 2022 collection is the plan in effect for the 2022 election and its 2024 pages say Alaska had no change from 2022 to 2024; the cached cb_2024 file matches the Division's May 24, 2022 designations by place (Eagle River is in House 23, Chugiak and Eklutna 24, North Muldoon 22, Girdwood 9, Spenard 14) and nests House districts in Senate districts as they do (K = 21 and 22, L = 23 and 24), so the 2022 file holds this plan. The 2022 file itself was not on disk to compare, so this rests on Census' no-change statement.
